Use 2002-07-01 in the source-date trailer, restricting the correction to the existing November 2026 snapshot range, with no reconstruction of earlier wording.

date_assessment.title: Section 45-37A-51.306 Employees of the Library Board.

Subsection (a) expressly covers past, present and future service; no current-wording commencement date is stated. Preserve the labelled 2026-11-03 retrieval fallback only for the existing snapshot correction.
